integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible standard-library checker included. Existing spherical two-point Blaschke--Petkantschin formula explicitly credited; no independent review or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only surface-area-uniform pairs on symmetric equatorial zones of the round two-sphere; no results for asymmetric belts, nonround spheres or general densities. The thin-zone limit does not assert continuity at the singular equator sampling model.
title: Exact geodesic escape probability for equatorial spherical zones
